lead.headline: Your morning market story will lead here
lead.dek: Each day the AI writes a short overview of overall sentiment, the major index and crypto moves, and the two or three events driving markets.
body: This is a sample edition showing the layout. Once your daily workflow is connected, this space will hold a real summary written from that morning's news and data.
The overview is capped at about 150 words so you can read it in under a minute before the US open.
